topic: Measuring Mass and Temperature with Simple Science Equipment
key_concepts: Science equipment can be used to measure mass and temperature.
Balances or scales are used to measure mass.
Thermometers are used to measure temperature.
Different measuring tools are appropriate for different samples or tests.
An analytical balance is used to measure mass precisely.
Taring removes the mass of an empty container before measuring a sample.
The mass of a liquid can be measured by placing it in a container on a balance.

Repeated trials are used to check measurements.
